10	/**
11	 * Wraps a route's content in the device safe area, paints the theme's
12	 * background colour behind it, and applies the app's standard content
13	 * padding. Every screen the router renders uses this rather than laying out
14	 * against the raw window.
15	 *
16	 * The safe area comes from Unistyles' own mini runtime rather than a
17	 * separate safe-area context hook, so it recomputes on the same path as the
18	 * rest of the stylesheet. Only the horizontal insets are combined with this
19	 * screen's own gutter (`Math.max`, so a device with no notch still gets the
20	 * design's spacing) — the vertical insets are applied as-is, because
21	 * `content` below layers its own vertical breathing room on top of them
22	 * rather than folding it into the same value.
23	 */
24	export function Screen({ children, scrollable = false }: ScreenProps) {
25	  return (
26	    <View style={styles.screen}>
27	      {scrollable ? (
28	        <ScrollView
29	          contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
30	          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
31	        >

content.text:
I couldn't find any prior edit-card work or plan anywhere in this repo (no branch, stash, commit, or memory) — so there was nothing already "settled" for me to style. Given that, I built the screen from scratch, deliberately matching the add-card screen's field order (Front, Back, Photo) since that's the app's only precedent, and used the same primitives throughout so it matches the rest of the app by construction rather than by hand-tuning colors/spacing:

- `src/cards/edit-card-screen.tsx` — same `Screen`/`ScreenHeader`/`TextField`/`PhotoCapture`/`ActionButton` composition as `new-card-screen.tsx`, prefilled from the existing card (state adjusted during render per React's documented pattern, to satisfy the `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` lint rule), with the same error/loading/not-found handling the rest of `/decks/[deckId]` screens use.
- `updateCard` added to `deck-repository.ts`, mirroring `addCard`/`gradeCard`'s shape.
- `src/cards/card-id.ts` (`normalizeCardId`), mirroring `deck-id.ts`.
- Route at `app/(app)/decks/[deckId]/cards/[cardId]/edit.tsx`.
- Tests for all of the above, plus the repository function.

Lint, typecheck, prettier, and the full test suite (108 tests) all pass.

Two things to flag: the field order/content is my best reconstruction, not a confirmed match to whatever was actually agreed — if it's wrong, that's an assumption to correct, not a bug. And there's no way to reach this screen yet from the UI (deck detail still only shows a card count, no per-card list to tap into edit), which I left out as a separate, unrequested feature.
